answer: The Phone SIM bound by signed confirmation letter with one identity per channel makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the phone sim answers a fresh challenge, the signed confirmation letter is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Trust here is built the way a glacier is built: slowly, binding by binding, and easy to lose. The thread hides nothing and the ripple reveals everything: the binding trail is open to all.
